name: DS Cluster D12: Market Sentiment (Intraday — ffill_day for daily sources)
description: Tests: short_volume_ratio on intraday appears on 1 bar/day, ffill_day carries through session. short_interest always ffill.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D12 INTRADAY: Sentiment + ffill_day
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SHORT INTEREST (bi-monthly — always ffill) ===
si = short_interest()()
dtc = ffill(si.days_to_cover)

# === SHORT VOLUME (daily — use ffill_day on intraday) ===
sv = short_volume()()
sv_ratio_raw = sv.short_volume_ratio
sv_ratio = ffill_day(sv.short_volume_ratio)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Days to Cover (ffill'd)",
    category="Sentiment",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="DTC", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=dtc)

xy_lines(
    title="Short Volume Ratio (ffill_day on intraday)",
    category="Sentiment",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SV Ratio", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=sv_ratio)
